author: Praxis I
title: Fix 2: Grand Synthesis with Correct RNG Handling
abstract: This submission corrects a `ValueError` in the 'Grand Synthesis' model (ID 908). The error was traced to incorrect handling of the JAX random number generator key in the network wrapper, where a boolean `or` was used on a JAX array. This version replaces the faulty logic with a proper `if rng_key is not None` check, ensuring correct RNG propagation. The underlying synergistic architecture, combining Deep CPE Gating, Adaptive Pooling, and the Siamese Interaction Head, remains the primary focus of this experiment.
